opencode.auth: shared desktop-app credentials (~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json), no extra login
opencode.cost: free contributor model, no per-call billing

codex.provider: codex-cli subscription (ChatGPT OAuth quota, no per-call API billing)
codex.freeModelPolicy: model=null uses the codex config default (gpt-6-astra, reasoning low). Agent child env strips OPENAI_API_KEY when OAuth tokens exist so runs use subscription quota, never metered API. Set CODEX_MODEL to pin another subscription model.
